description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath, wielding martial prowess and divine magic.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.tldr: Open your awareness to detect celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.tldr: A pool of healing power lets you restore hit points or cure diseases by touching creatures.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.tldr: Adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty (Defense, Dueling, Great Weapon Fighting, Protection).

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You can cast divine paladin spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.tldr: Expended spell slots can be channeled into weapon strikes to deal extra radiant damage to targets.

features.name: Divine Health
features.tldr: The divine magic flowing through you makes you immune to disease.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.tldr: Swear an oath that binds you to a holy path, granting specialized features and spells.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.tldr: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.tldr: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet gain a bonus to saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Sacred Oath Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Sacred Oath.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.tldr: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet cannot be frightened while you are conscious.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.tldr: Your melee weapon attacks are infused with divine power, dealing extra radiant damage on every hit.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.tldr: Use your touch to end one spell on yourself or a willing creature.

features.name: Sacred Oath Feature
features.tldr: Gain a specialized feature granted by your chosen Sacred Oath.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Aura Improvements
features.tldr: The range of your aura features (Protection, Courage, and subclass auras) increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Sacred Oath Capstone
features.tldr: Gain the ultimate avatar transformation feature granted by your chosen Sacred Oath.
